notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Program.Talents.cs is a full talent window: 384x512 chassis with the four-piece shell art, per-tab class background tiles (MageFire etc.), 3 tree tabs (VanillaTab), scrolled 296x332 grid with wheel + real scrollbar (arrows/knob/track drag), talent buttons with EmptySlot backdrop / icon grey-out / RankBorder + rank text with maxed-gold coloring, prerequisite link lines colored by met/unmet, points-remaining display, eligibility law (tier 5-per-row gating, prerequisite rank, required spell, free points), CMSG_LEARN_TALENT send with server confirm observation, talent-wipe cost display + Unlearn Talents confirm, Close + minimize close button, player portrait. TalentCatalog decodes Talent/TalentTab DBC.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: Prerequisite dependencies are drawn as plain colored lines instead of the ref's UI-TalentBranches/UI-TalentArrows tile textures, and the talent tooltip is a basic ImGui tooltip (name/rank/reason) rather than the full spell tooltip with next-rank text. Both read as deliberate simplified looks of the same function - candidates for ruling rather than hard gaps.
